memories.title: Kusto query best practices
memories.summary: Bound every KQL query by time before joins.
memories.body_markdown:
## Practice
Start with `where Timestamp > ago(24h)`, project only required columns, then join.

memories.title: Kusto cross-cluster join pitfall
memories.summary: Filter and summarize the remote side before a cross-cluster join.
memories.body_markdown: 未经筛选的跨集群 join 会放大数据传输。先过滤时间并 summarize。

memories.title: Legacy Kusto query guidance
memories.summary: Query the full table and filter afterward.
memories.body_markdown: This guidance is intentionally stale.

memories.title: KQL function naming
memories.summary: Use the `crm_` prefix for stored KQL functions.
memories.body_markdown: Stored functions owned by this repository use snake_case names beginning with `crm_`.

memories.title: Telemetry retention
memories.summary: Keep hot telemetry for 30 days.
memories.body_markdown:
## Decision
Use a 30-day hot retention period and archive older data.

memories.title: Do not log cluster credentials
memories.summary: Kusto credentials must never enter diagnostic logs.
memories.body_markdown: Redact authorization headers and connection strings.

memories.title: Investigate ingestion lag
memories.summary: Compare source timestamps with ingestion_time().
memories.body_markdown: Use `extend lag = ingestion_time() - Timestamp` and summarize percentiles.

memories.title: Dashboard time range
memories.summary: Dashboards default to the last 24 hours.
memories.body_markdown: Every workbook must expose a time-range parameter and default to 24 hours.

memories.title: Kusto 查询检查清单
memories.summary: 限定时间、减少列、最后排序。
memories.body_markdown: 查询 Kusto 时先限定时间范围，只投影需要的列，并避免对完整结果集排序。

memories.title: Pending materialized-view warning
memories.summary: A possible issue with materialized views.
memories.body_markdown: This candidate has not been reviewed.

memories.title: Checkout idempotency keys
memories.summary: Every payment attempt requires an idempotency key.
memories.body_markdown: Persist the key with the payment result for 24 hours.

memories.title: Retry transient payment failures
memories.summary: Use bounded exponential backoff for transient gateway errors.
memories.body_markdown: Retry at most three times with jitter; never retry a hard decline.

memories.title: Do not retry hard declines
memories.summary: A declined card is not a transient transport error.
memories.body_markdown: Return the decline result without scheduling another charge.

memories.title: Currency amount representation
memories.summary: Represent money in minor units as integers.
memories.body_markdown: Never use binary floating point for currency.

memories.title: Gateway timeout
memories.summary: Use a five-second payment gateway timeout.
memories.body_markdown: The old ten-second timeout has been replaced.

memories.title: Old gateway timeout
memories.summary: Use a ten-second payment gateway timeout.
memories.body_markdown: This decision is superseded.

memories.title: Reconcile settlement files
memories.summary: Import each settlement file exactly once.
memories.body_markdown: Hash the file before import and retain the reconciliation report.

memories.title: Legacy webhook signature
memories.summary: An obsolete signature-validation warning.
memories.body_markdown: This memory is archived.

memories.title: Payment correlation IDs
memories.summary: Propagate one correlation ID through checkout and gateway calls.
memories.body_markdown: Use the incoming request ID unless the edge did not provide one.
